Name: Kenneth's Seed Shop
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Seed Shop[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]A seed shop that adds new fruits to grow.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What is inside[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- 15 new fruits like Crisp Red Apple, Tart Light Green Apple, Juicy Mandarin Orange, Ripe Meadow Strawberry, Watermelon, Honeydew Melon, Sunset Mango, Banana, Grapes, Peach, Lemon, Lime, Cherries, Pear and more[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Each fruit comes with its own sapling[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- All fruits can be turned on or off in GMCM[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Shop location can be changed in GMCM and defaults to Shop5[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Generic Mod Config Menu recommended for changing shop location and toggling fruits[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Unzip this mod into your Mods folder[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Run the game with SMAPI[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with most content mods.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Made by Kf29 aka Kenneth[/b][/size]
